title: Application.
officialText:
Minimum headlap for slate shingles shall be in accordance with Table 1507.7.6. Slate shingles shall be
secured to the roof with two fasteners per slate.
TABLE 1507.7.6
SLATE SHINGLE HEADLAP
HEADLAP
SLOPE (inches)
4:12 < slope < 8:12 4
8:12 < slope < 20:12 3
slop e ≥ 2 0 :1 2 2
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm.
